ddl:
CREATE TABLE Author (
    Author_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Email VARCHAR(255),
    Gender VARCHAR(255),
    Introduction VARCHAR(255),
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Phone VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Article (
    Article_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Article_collection_volume INTEGER,
    Article_comment_volume INTEGER,
    Article_content VARCHAR(255),
    Article_like_volume INTEGER,
    Article_reading_volume INTEGER,
    Article_title VARCHAR(255),
    Creation_time DATETIME,
    Last_modification_and_save_author_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Last_modification_and_save_time DATETIME,
    Total_number_of_words_in_the_article INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (Last_modification_and_save_author_ID) REFERENCES Author(Author_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Author_creates_article (
    Article_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Author_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Author_order INTEGER,
    Author_responsible_for_part VARCHAR(255),
    Author_role VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (Article_ID, Author_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Article_ID) REFERENCES Article(Article_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Author_ID) REFERENCES Author(Author_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Author_modifies_article (
    Article_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Author_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Modify_notes VARCHAR(255),
    Modify_save_time DATETIME,
    Modify_start_time DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY (Article_ID, Author_ID, Modify_save_time),
    FOREIGN KEY (Article_ID) REFERENCES Article(Article_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Author_ID) REFERENCES Author(Author_ID)
);
gold_question: The article management system manages multiple articles. Each article has an article ID, article title, article content, creation time, total number of words, article reading volume, article like volume, article collection volume, article comment volume, the time of the last modification and save, and the author ID of the last modification and save. The system also manages multiple authors. Each author has an author ID, name, gender, phone number, email address, and introduction. Each article can be created by multiple authors, and the author order, responsible part, and role of each author are recorded. Authors can modify articles, and each modification records the modification start time, modification save time, and modification notes. The system ensures the accuracy of article content and the transparency of author contributions by recording article creation and modification information.
